summary: Real-tmux tests close the loop on observable session state: on a fresh socket the production new_session_argv path yields `show-options -A -t test mouse` == `mouse* on` (stock default is off, so a config lacking/negating the line fails), and the repair test pre-sets `mouse off` on an existing server and asserts production session creation flips it back on; the four call-site argv tests (local/shell runner, dashboard, _start_sessions) plus the shell-runner live-socket spawn reject a call site that drops `-f`/`source-file` — the pure string check on config text is weak alone but is not the only coverage.
